title: `createERC20DAO()` will always revert when `_depositChainIds` has a length bigger than 1
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Whenever we call `createERC20DAO()`, we have the following **if** check:  ```solidity if (_depositChainIds.length > 1) ```  If we end up in there, we will always revert. This is due to this line:  ```solidity IEmitter(emitterAddress).createCCDao(_daoAddress, _depositChainIds); ```  It calls `createCCDao()` on the `Emitter` contract however that function is not implemented there.
